title: Greenhub Bermgras Canvas qualitative site-quality and routing guidance
source_title: Keuzehulp van bermvak tot toepassing: Slimme keuzes voor bermmaaisel
authors: Greenhub Zuid-Holland; knowledge and practice contributions from the Rijnland project partners
persistent_identifier: No DOI or persistent publication identifier identified; local source_id SRC-GHZH-KEUZEHULP-2025 and dataset URN are used.
geography: South Holland, Netherlands; qualitative guidance developed for Dutch roadside verge management
license: No explicit reuse license for the PDF identified; factual criteria are summarized with source attribution, and the source document is not redistributed.
source_location: Printed page 22, Step 3: origin and composition of roadside cuttings; quality assurance, litter, and invasive species.
related_standard_reference: The guide maps green/orange/red area classes to CROW visual litter-quality levels A+/A, B, and C/D. This extract preserves the guide's mapping; it does not independently validate or replace the CROW quality catalog.
data_handling: English summaries preserve the guide's qualitative rules. No numerical threshold, contamination prevalence, biomass share, cleaning efficiency, or route-specific rejection fraction is inferred. All records are reference-only and not model inputs.
limitations: This is operational screening guidance, not a measured dataset, scientific literature result, legal product standard, or validated GreenHub biorefinery acceptance specification.
No numeric contamination limits, chemical analyses, microplastic measurements, sampling protocol, or mass/flow quantities are provided.
The guide states that choices depend on each location and situation and should be agreed among partners; the color categories must not be applied as universal process exclusion rules.
The guide's local soil/circular-use pathway is not identical to GreenHub's biorefinery route; route compatibility needs site-specific testing.
